operating_notes.text: Responsive Industries scaled its White Label and OEM business lines across domestic and international markets.
FY26 traded-goods purchases were ₹660.88 Cr, 47% of revenue, against ₹653.53 Cr in FY25.
Consolidated trade receivables rose to ₹742.02 Cr at Mar-2026 from ₹583.33 Cr a year earlier.
Fairpoint Tradecom LLP (Promoter Group) holds 2,46,50,000 shares, 9.25% of Responsive Industries' capital, of which 90,95,971 shares (3.41%) were pledged as of 29-Sep-2026.

The pledges are for margin/depository trading funding for personal use by promoters and PACs, with Central Depository Services (India) Limited named as the entity in whose favour shares are encumbered.

timeline.summary: Responsive Industries reported that promoter group Fairpoint Tradecom released a pledge on 300,000 shares.
Responsive Industries announced a strategic scale-up of its white label and OEM business operations across global markets.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹430.34 Cr (+13.1% YoY), net profit ₹22.82 Cr (-57.9% YoY).

Promoter group (Wellknown Business Ventures LLP, Fairpoint Tradecom LLP, Efficient Builders LLP, Mavi Business Ventures LLP, and Agarwal family members) disclosed shareholding under SEBI’s Regulations 30(1), 30(2), and 31(4) on April 07, 2026, with no new encumbrances.

On 15-Oct-2026 Responsive Industries disclosed that promoter-group entity Fairpoint Tradecom LLP released 10,00,000 pledged shares on 24-25 Sep 2026 and created a fresh pledge of 10,00,000 shares on 29-Sep-2026, leaving 3.41% of capital encumbered.
